newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil judge still mulling cellular injunction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil judge still mulling cellular injunction.

text.p: A Brazilian judge has not yet announced his ruling on a request for an injunction to suspend the government cellular telephone concession plan, despite local news reports he rejected the request, an official said.
"No decision has been announced," said a court official.

Local newswire Invest News said the judge had rejected a case brought by a telecommunications workers' trade union. The workers group had alleged the government's plan to offer private groups concessions to run B Band cellular services was unconstitutional.

The case is separate from a left-wing opposition suit against the government's B Band program currently being studied in the Supreme Federal Tribunal, Brazil's highest court. That ruling was suspended for ten days on Thursday.
